card.name: Loc at the start of local-words
card.fires_on: The fragment "Loc" (or "local") that begins words like locals, locally and locoregional, often right after a sentence break or heading.

card.writes: It promotes odd word-continuation pieces and suppresses "local" forms, so it discourages repeating "local" after one has just appeared.
card.plain: It fires on the start of words like locals, locally and locoregional.
